description.value: Shio Japanese Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant that opened on The High Street in Coquitlam in May 2018, serving a mix of traditional sushi and original dishes like the Katsu Burger. It sits in a busy commercial hub near Douglas College, Lafarge Lake, and Coquitlam Centre, with free underground parking accessible off Atlantic Ave. Dine-in and takeout are both available, with Uber Eats delivery as well.

address.value: 102 – 1168 The High Street, Coquitlam, BC V3B 0C6
